params: How high she rises at the top of each hop, in pixels. Low is a shuffle along the row; high is a proper leap with air under her.
How long she floats at the top of the hop. Zero crosses the gap at one steady speed; high launches hard, hangs, then drops onto the plant.
How far her head drives into the tomato on each strike, in pixels. The violence of a single peck.
How hard she shakes her head side to side while tearing flesh off the fruit, in pixels.
How many juice, seed and pulp particles each bite throws. The size of the mess she leaves on the row.
The pull on the juice she throws off. Low leaves it hanging in the air; high drops it straight into the soil.
How the stripped plant leaves the frame. Zero drags it off at a constant speed; high whips it away and lets the last of it coast out.
